I wish there were a Stainless Steel option for the cooking grates, though.  And 4 smaller grids, instead of 2 large ones. We had two week old corn sitting around, and cooking it on the Weber grill didn't make it any fresher -- actually it was soggy.  Fresh corn and meat cook more than great.  After three years of not having a grill, I'm grateful to have one again.  We've now gone from natural gas to propane, and I hope this is not a problem, especially in the Ohio winter.  What amazes me is how the push button start works -- lets see how long that lasts.

 I gave it four stars because no one ever reads the five star ratings, and I've only had the grill for a month.
Results.Title: Works great, but...

Results.ReviewText:
In the past, I purchased other brands of grills and they never did a good job of distributing the flame evenly. My Weber is great! We never have an issue with cooking on either side or loading up the grill with chicken, burgers and corn and everything is cooked perfectly.

I like the tank load feature that lets you know when the gas is running low and the exterior is easy to clean (soap and water) as well as the inside.

I'd highly recommend a Weber grill for those people that wonder if an extra $50 - $100 more (versus other grills) is worth it.....it is!

The only thing I would change is the tank weighing hook for the propane. It is not easy to be lifting a full tank while bending over to set it in the slot for the scale that tells you if the tank is full or empty. I think a platform under the tank would have been easier to use for us over 60 crowd. Other than that I wouldn't change a thing and look forward to many years of use with a great Weber Product.

Results.ReviewText: Bought the grill a couple of months ago after our little tailgater grill has seen it's last days.  Wanted to get a decent grill not a no name because we've had them in the past and you get what you pay for.  I love this grill because its the perfect size for my husband and I and when he goes TDY which he often does I can still fire up the grill and cook for myself, I LOVE BBQ FOODS.  I use it more often then my husband only because since we've had it he's been in school.  We are military and our the grills first move is rounding the corner, I'm hoping we have a good moving company that will treat it with care.  So far, steaks have been cooked to perfection on this grill, the temperature control is pretty awesome and both sides heat up (not used to that, lol),  I like the little shelf grate above the cooking grates to keep foods hot without over cooking to much.  I still need to work on my chicken cooking skills.  Easy to light, love how the tank is hidden, the sides come down and is an east set up.  If it's just a couple of you or family of 4 or 5 I would recommend this.  It is the perfect size for us.  Looking forward to years of cooking on this grill.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
